entries.title: The Botanica
body: The naaru used this satellite of Tempest Keep to gather unusual life from across Outland and keep it safe behind special wards. When Kael'thas took the keep, his blood elves set to work at once to unlock the power hidden in Outland's plants and the naaru's secrets. Their scientists experiment on the flora, and on how naaru technology can create and shape living things, and grant the blood elves new power.

entries.title: The Bloodwarder Halls
body: The halls where the Bloodwarder soldiers stand guard, and the herbalists grow Thalassian trees brought from home alongside olemba trees and Zangarmarsh fungi.

entries.title: The Sunseeker Gardens
body: The deeper gardens, with red crystals like those of Bloodmyst Isle, whose radiations the Sunseekers may be learning to manipulate. In the last room an ancient of the arcane has taken root.

entries.title: Commander Sarannis
body: A blood elf warrior in command of the Bloodwarder soldiers in the Botanica, entrusted with the Keystone.

entries.title: High Botanist Freywinn
body: An herbalist who seems to run the blood elves' experiments on plants in the Botanica. He has found time to write a comprehensive botanist's field guide.

entries.title: Thorngrin the Tender
body: A keeper of the Botanica's gardens.

entries.title: Laj
body: A great lasher grown in the Botanica's gardens.

entries.title: Warp Splinter
body: A huge ancient of the arcane, the strangest growth in the naaru's garden.
